title: Payment Gateway Timeout
content: Payment transactions failed because the payment gateway timeout was configured too aggressively at 10 seconds. During periods of increased gateway latency, requests timed out before the gateway completed processing.

title: Payment Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
content: Payment transactions experienced failures when the database connection pool reached its maximum capacity. Long-running payment queries caused connections to remain occupied.

title: Payment Gateway Latency
content: A significant increase in external payment gateway latency resulted in payment requests exceeding the configured timeout threshold.

title: Payment Database Failure
content: Payment processing degraded after database connections were exhausted by long-running transactions. New payment requests could not obtain database connections.
